Subject: Post-call: VPC/private deployment options & next steps

Hi Sam / Priya 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Great conversation. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our end: 

Summary of needs (per our call)
- High-throughput inference for card-not-present fraud scoring (p95 latency target ~120ms)
- Data residency & strict egress controls for EU/US customers
- Multi-tenant isolation with dedicated networking for production models

What we recommended
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) for predictable throughput during batch windows + hosted fallback for spikes
- Private VPC deployment (customer VPC peering or on-prem option) to meet your compliance/egress requirements
- Optional HSM/KMS key integration for model request encryption at rest

Next steps I mentioned
1) I attached a short VPC architecture diagram and a draft SLA that outlines latency & uptime targets we can commit to for Dedicated. Please review (redwood-vpc-architecture.pdf, redwood-sla-draft-acme-2027.docx).
2) If the VPC/on-prem option looks necessary from a compliance perspective, we can set up an architecture call with our solutions engineer (Jonas) to walk through networking and procurement timelines.
3) If you want to move forward with Dedicated, we can spin up a sizing worksheet. I can send that over once you confirm expected QPS and peak sequence length.

Quick ask: could you confirm whether VPC/on-prem is a blocker for your security team, or whether Dedicated (with private networking + strict ingress rules) would suffice? That will help us prioritize the right onboarding path.

I'll plan to follow up next week if I don't hear back. Wanted to get this in your inbox while it's fresh.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Hi Sam / Priya 

Following up on Marissa's note. If helpful for planning, quick answers to likely questions from your security/compliance team: 

- Network models: we support VPC peering, PrivateLink-style endpoints, and an on-prem gateway option for air-gapped deployments.
- Data controls: request/response logs can be routed to your KMS-backed storage; we also offer configurable retention windows per environment.
- Timeline: for a standard VPC peering + Dedicated capacity setup, most customers complete networking and validation within 3-6 weeks once procurement is in place; on-prem timelines vary based on infra approvals.

If VPC is a blocker, please flag that here, we'll treat it as a procurement priority and prepare a security package (SOC2 artifacts, network runbook) for your reviewers.

To make the next step concrete: are you able to confirm priority/expected timeline (Pilot within 30 days / Q2 evaluation / later)? Also, would you prefer a 30-min technical session this week (Thu/Fri) or next Tue?

Happy to coordinate calendar invites.

Best,
